name: Gan Assurances
verdict: Gan Assurances is part of the Groupama group, a French mutual insurance group owned by its sociétaires (members). Nothing found.
note: Rating note: major partner of FDJ United-Suez since June 2025 (logo on the sleeves and right chest of the jersey for three seasons, per the club communiqué). The owner is the Groupama mutual group; no state or fund owner identified in the chain.
